name: Ryan Brosas Brand System
description: A practical, failure-aware brand system for explaining and presenting agent systems that remove recurring work from overworked founders.

logo.notes: Use the charcoal mark on light surfaces, coral as a controlled accent, signal yellow on charcoal, and white on charcoal or coral. Preserve the 255 × 211 geometry and optically center the visible glyph.

display.notes: Normal-width display face; create energy through scale and alignment, not condensed geometry.

body.notes: Comfortable long-viewing body text with 1.55–1.65 line height.

mono.notes: Use only for indices, labels, status, specifications, and technical evidence.

rules: Create editorial energy through scale, alignment, repetition, and crop.
Reserve mono for indices, status, specifications, tokens, and technical evidence.

voice.tone: A practical builder thinking through real systems in public, reporting failures plainly and avoiding hype.
messagingPillars: Show context, checks, handoffs, and recovery.
Share what worked, what broke, and what remains Open.
deliveryRules: Lead with the operating consequence, then explain the mechanism.
Name the evidence source when a claim is Verified.
State the tradeoff when a recommendation is Proposed.
Use 'Still needed:' when proof remains Open.
Prefer one concrete sentence over a stack of abstract benefits.
Write error and recovery copy as what happened, what remains safe, and what the person can do next.
Use specific action verbs such as inspect, validate, retry, copy, compare, and document.

proofBoundaryPatterns.Verified: The source files show [specific evidence], so [safe use].
proofBoundaryPatterns.Proposed: I'd use [choice] because [operating benefit]; the tradeoff is [cost or constraint].
proofBoundaryPatterns.Open: Still needed: [owned proof] before [decision or publication].

surfaceRules: A headline names the operating consequence before the mechanism.
A control label uses a concrete verb and object.
A status sentence names its source, tradeoff, or missing proof.
Do not stack abstract benefit nouns when one observable action will do.
Landing-page sections use one claim, one mechanism, and one evidence boundary rather than a pile of benefits.
Component guidance uses imperative verbs and names the implementation file when reuse is expected.

microcopyContracts.action: Use a concrete verb plus object, usually two to four words; name the destination when navigation is the result.
microcopyContracts.disclosure: Name the content that opens or closes; do not use a bare icon when a visible label fits.
microcopyContracts.loading: Describe the work in progress and preserve the control width, for example Checking source.
microcopyContracts.errorRecovery: State what happened, what remains safe, and the next available action.
microcopyContracts.evidence: Name the owned source when Verified, the tradeoff when Proposed, and the exact proof still needed when Open.

acceptanceTest.passesWhen: The copy names the work, the system choice, the evidence boundary, and the next step without hype.
acceptanceTest.failsWhen: The copy could belong to any AI consultancy after replacing the name.
checks: A Verified claim names its source.
A Proposed claim names its tradeoff.
An Open claim starts with 'Still needed:' and names the proof.
An error message names a recovery action.

imagery.style: Owned operational evidence first, supported by one approved clean-print hero and approved operational illustrations for narrative moments.
imagery.treatment: Contain screenshots inside clear evidence plates. Use the approved System Conductor as the primary campaign and cover hero. Place every approved transparent illustration with its full silhouette and clear margin intact; use illustration as narrative support, never operating proof.

hero.placement: Primary hero for website openings, presentation covers, campaign openers, and major section introductions. Use on a light semantic surface or a protected light plate over charcoal.

postureRules: Keep workbench surfaces calm, flat, modular, and readable.
Reserve collage, large crops, and abrupt scale shifts for presentation moments.
Use one decisive visual flourish per screen.
Repeat coral and ration signal yellow.
Center the visible logo glyph optically inside every tile.

measuredSource.linkedFigmaStatus: The Figma node 8439:28792 remains the structural reference. It was not available for measurement in this run, so no value was inferred from it. The re-measured local HTML, CSS, SVGs, palette assets, component previews, and owned renders remain authoritative.

identity.name: Ryan Brosas
identity.primaryStatement: I build agent systems so repetitive work stops coming back to you.
identity.campaignLine: Building systems so everything doesn’t need you.

audience.primary: Overworked founders whose recurring work and decisions still route back through them.
audience.secondary: Operators, agency owners, developers, and advanced builders working on context, evaluation, handoffs, and reliability.

runtime.contentSafety: All data-driven text and attribute values pass through BrandEscape before HTML composition.
runtime.rule: Preview HTML documents component states; reusable implementation comes from the runtime component files and is rendered by the applied kit. Declared lifecycle states must be visibly exercised by the applied kit, data-driven values must be escaped, and the source and distribution directories contain exactly the seven allowed files. Unrelated prototypes stay in revision evidence.

components.navigation: Three primary workbook pages plus secondary Personal and Client track controls.
components.button: Primary, secondary, quiet, selected, loading, disabled, and focus-visible states with dedicated border and loading roles.
components.panel: Low-radius evidence module using semantic surface, text, stroke, and status roles.
components.form: Visible label, 44px input, focus, read-only, disabled, validating, valid, and invalid contracts with plain-language messages.
components.status: Verified, Proposed, and Open are written labels and must not rely on color alone.
components.themeControl: A labelled light/dark preference that writes data-theme on the owned root and persists locally.
components.projectEvidence: A request for owned proof; never a polished fake screenshot.
components.feedback: Neutral, error, and notice surfaces name the event and the next action; color never carries the message alone.
components.evidenceMedia: Owned captures use a fixed media plate, source label, caption, and explicit Open, loading, empty, error, and recovery states without hiding uncertainty behind decorative imagery.
components.lifecycle: Reusable components preserve geometry through default, loading or validating, content or empty, error, and recovery states.

assets.utilityIconContract: 24px grid, 1.75px currentColor outline with round caps and joins. Bind currentColor through --icon-default, --icon-muted, --icon-inverse, or --icon-disabled. The same geometry must render charcoal on near-white and near-white on charcoal; static Showcase proofs inline canonical geometry so icons remain visible in captures. Use only for navigation, disclosure, direction, copy, recovery, and written-state reinforcement; visible labels remain the default.
assets.livingAppliedRule: Continuously improve the canonical landing page, regenerate showcase-landing-page.html for Design System Assets, and refresh its capture after accepted revisions. Keep identity, hero, editorial, and interface asset roles distinct.
assets.referenceBoardUsage: Contained inspiration only; do not copy third-party material.

implementation.systemVariablesContract: tokens.css and system/variables.css are self-contained generated mirrors of colors_and_type.css; all three files must remain byte-identical and must not rely on @import.
implementation.consumerTokenContract: Generated artifacts load tokens.css once. Package maintainers edit colors_and_type.css, then regenerate tokens.css and system/variables.css; consumers do not load multiple mirrors.
implementation.contentSafetyContract: Registered runtime components escape data-driven text and attributes through BrandEscape; static trusted SVG geometry may remain literal.
implementation.componentApplicationContract: Load tokens.css once, load primitives before composed components, and render only components listed in component-manifest.json.
